clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, a Glyphic Tablet sends young Horde mages to Mai'ah. Gornek passes it to them after they prove their strength, and the troll trainer waits outside the Den.

You have proved your strength against the Valley of Trials' wildlife, and Gornek gives you an inscribed tablet. Mai'ah, the valley's mage trainer, sent it. She asks you to find her by the Den's entrance when you are ready to begin your arcane studies.

Mai'ah speaks plainly about the power mages wield and the danger that comes with it. She warns that their greatest threat is magic's unseen pull toward corruption, not rival warriors or enemy races. Humility and patience matter, she says, because unchecked sorcery can make a mage believe they have mastered more than they have.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ya look to please Mai'ah already, friend. Dat be good. You give Mai'ah respect, and Mai'ah maybe give you respect back. But enough o' dat, you be here to learn 'bout magic, not hear Mai'ah talk.
There be only one ting Mai'ah can no teach you 'bout magic, friend, and dat's how to stop da corruptin'.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You be among da most powerful beings on da planet, friend... There no arguin' dat. And everyone know it... Know it good, too!

But ya must be weary! 'cause it not orc, or elf, or dwarf dat you should be scared of... It be da tings you can'na see. Magic be powerful. Make you do tings you may not want to do. Make ya tink you more powerful then you really be. Be patient. Be smart.
When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
